column6: format only: added missing blank line before ## Questions (renders either way; not counted)
ΔH is similar overstated for Ni2+ (about -100 vs -117 kJ/mol; entropy is the larger part, not the only one); copied from file's Explainer. Now "TΔS differs more than ΔH does"

bullet 1: "Ni-N bonds are similar in strength" overstated (en has a more negative ΔH); softened to "enthalpy changes differ only modestly; most of the gain". Older Explainer error not in scope: says acetylacetonate forms five-membered rings (it forms six-membered)
bullet 2: "only when Δ > P" false for d1-d3 and d8-d10, where the lower set fills first regardless; limited to d4-d7

bullet 3: "oxidation states up to +6" for U, Np, Pu; Np and Pu reach +7 (copied from file's "+3 to +6" question). Older Explainer overstates: lanthanide contraction "exactly cancels" the 5d size increase

bullet 2: listed +1/-1/0 as the only character values; unshifted pi (vector) orbitals give fractional values (e.g. 0 under C4, -1/2 under C3), and the How sends readers to the pi case. Recast +1/-1 as sigma examples
bullet 4 deleted: "longer-lived emission comes from slower absorption" is a strawman; 3 bullets remain. Also added missing blank line before ## Questions
bullet 1: "each added component contributes less than the one before" false for the two equal pi components; restated as pi and delta weaker than sigma, delta weakest
bullet 2: called F- a "moderate Δ" ligand; F- is weak-field. Replaced with the Cl- vs F- order reversal between the two series

five-coordinate and seven-coordinate structures each mechanism implies mismatched the octahedral-D vs square-planar-A comparison (both give five-coordinate intermediates); now names square pyramid and trigonal bipyramid
bullet 4 belief "Cobaltocene is stable" is not clearly false (it is isolable); belief now "as air-stable as ferrocene"
